name: KY-022 infrared receiver
not_buildable: It receives remote-control codes that have to be decoded. It needs an extra Arduino library, and LearnLens only compiles sketches with its two approved libraries.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a receiver in a silver metal cage with a dark dome at the front.

facts.statement: The receiver turns 38 kHz infrared remote-control signals into a digital sequence; operating voltage 3.3 V to 5 V. The vendor's example uses the IRremote library.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-022, technical data and code example
